faq.q: How much does custom software development cost in Surat?
faq.a: It depends on scope — a simple billing tool costs far less than a full ERP or SaaS platform. You get a clear, itemized quote after a free scoping call, with no hidden charges and phased milestone payments.

faq.q: How long does it take to build custom software?
faq.a: A focused MVP can be ready in 4 to 8 weeks. Larger ERP or SaaS builds run longer and are delivered in phases so you get usable software early.

faq.q: Do you build software with GST and UPI support?
faq.a: Yes. GST-compliant invoicing, UPI and payment gateway integration, and WhatsApp Business notifications are core to how we build.

faq.q: Will we own the source code?
faq.a: Yes — you own your code and data in full. We hand over everything and can support you afterward, but you are never locked in.

faq.q: Do you provide support after launch?
faq.a: Yes. We offer ongoing maintenance and support plans, plus continued feature development as your business grows.
